deep-voyager1.title: Jupiter Great Red Spot Mosaic
deep-voyager1.caption: Jupiter’s Great Red Spot, photographed by Voyager 1
deep-voyager1.alt: Jupiter’s clouds in cream and orange swirls, with the oval Great Red Spot at the top and a white oval storm below it.

deep-voyager2.title: PIA01492
deep-voyager2.caption: Neptune and its Great Dark Spot, photographed by Voyager 2
deep-voyager2.alt: Neptune, a deep blue globe with a dark oval storm near its middle edged by bright white clouds.

deep-newhorizons.title: The Rich Color Variations of Pluto
deep-newhorizons.credit: NASA/Johns Hopkins University Applied Physics Laboratory/Southwest Research Institute
deep-newhorizons.caption: Pluto in enhanced color, photographed by New Horizons
deep-newhorizons.alt: Pluto, a round world with a pale heart shaped plain on the right and dark red ground on the left, in enhanced color.

deep-pioneer10.title: ARC-1973-AC73-9253
deep-pioneer10.caption: Jupiter and one of its moons, top right, photographed by Pioneer 10 from 2,584,000 km
deep-pioneer10.alt: Jupiter as a banded orange and cream globe on black, with a small orange moon to its upper right.

deep-pioneer11.title: KSC-73P-0116
deep-pioneer11.caption: Pioneer 11, then called Pioneer G, between the open halves of its nose cover
deep-pioneer11.alt: Pioneer 11 under its round dish antenna, standing between the two open halves of its rocket nose cover.

home-dsn-goldstone.title: Goldstone 70-Meter
home-dsn-goldstone.caption: Goldstone’s 70 m antenna at night
home-dsn-goldstone.alt: A huge white dish antenna tilted toward the night sky above lit buildings in the desert, with the Moon to the right.

home-dsn-madrid.title: New All-in-One Antenna for the Deep Space Network
home-dsn-madrid.caption: Madrid’s 34 m antenna DSS 56 at night
home-dsn-madrid.alt: A white dish antenna facing straight up on a lit steel tower against a black night sky.

home-dsn-canberra.title: A Big Crane for a Big Dish
home-dsn-canberra.caption: Canberra’s 70 m antenna DSS 43 during its 2020 upgrade, with a crane beside it
home-dsn-canberra.alt: A giant white dish antenna under blue sky with a tall red and white crane beside it and green hills behind.

home-orbit-apollo14.title: Trail of Discovery at Fra Mauro
home-orbit-apollo14.caption: The Apollo 14 site and Cone crater, seen by the Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter
home-orbit-apollo14.alt: Grey cratered lunar ground from straight above, with the bright rim of Cone crater at top right and the astronauts’ faint trail at bottom left.
